newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's peso edges up in stable trading.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's peso edges up in stable trading.

text.p: Colombia's peso gained 55 centavos to close at 1,099.05 pesos to the dollar in stable trading Tuesday, interbank traders said.
"The market was very quiet and the rate moved by very small margins. People are waiting for the peso to rise to 1,097 before they start buying again," one dealer said.
The peso opened at 1,099 and edged to an intraday high of 1,098.8 before dipping to a low of 1,099.8. Dealers reported 260 trades worth a total $133 million, below the $180 million daily average.
